name: Omniburner
description: A universal Mini StealthBurner adaptation that supports multiple extruders in a single printed part via clever mounting point design. Uses sliding hex nuts and shared screw holes so users can swap between five different extruders in minutes without rewiring, major disassembly, or reprinting.
features: Supports 5+ extruders in one printed part
Sliding hex nut system for quick extruder swaps
No rewiring or major disassembly needed for swaps
Same PTFE tubes work across extruder configurations
Based on Mini StealthBurner extruder mounts by Jacob G
